title: Create: Seats Third Person
description: Third person with customizable zoom for create seats
body:
Create: Seats Third Person

 

![demo video](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1581680/description_3c1e198e-3f4a-42c4-9f79-ab37bc259540.gif)

  **A lightweight Create addon that lets you zoom out into third-person view while sitting on Create seats.** Perfect for watching your trains, airships and moving contraptions from the outside while still riding them.
## ✨ Features * Toggle a custom third-person seat camera * Zoom in and out while sitting on a Create seat * Works on moving contraptions, trains and aircraft * Restores your original camera view when you stand up * Fully rebindable controls
## ⚙️ How to Use * Sit on a Create seat and press **V** to enable the third-person camera. * Use the **mouse wheel** or the **\[ / \]** keys to adjust the zoom distance. * Press **V** again, or stand up, to return to your normal camera. * All keybinds can be changed in: * **Options → Controls → Create: Seats Third Person** **Note:** If you want to adjust the train speed while driving, you need to toggle the third-person camera off first (`V`), change the speed with the scroll wheel, then toggle it back on.
## Compatibility Works with Create trains, carriages, moving contraptions and Create: Aeronautics aircraft. Other seat-like contraptions can be supported through the client config.
## 🧩 More Create Addons by Us If you enjoy this addon, check out our other Create expansions: * [**⏳**] **[Create: Time Manipulator](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-time-manipulator)** — Bend time and weather using Create-powered mechanics.
Made by **Rampage99TV**
